title: Cluster 2 product architecture defined — Handles, cohort sharing, demand and consultation exchange specs
description: Four product architecture specs written to website/docs/: (1) cohort-sharing-contract.md — wheel registration, anonymized telemetry, 4-day free delay, hub routing hint; (2) handles-product-spec.md — product positioning, credit economy, Box.com track ingest, delayed reporting tiers, anti-gaming rankings; (3) demand-exchange-spec.md — feature voting, vendor segment mediation, no financial transactions v1; (4) consultation-exchange-spec.md — eject packet, trail preservation, return/provenance, per-eject consent, 72h purge. All 4 implementation lugs updated to 'implemented'. NOTE: specs are in website/docs/ markdown — architecture decisions not yet captured as decision lugs for WAI wakeup discoverability.
rationale: Cluster 1 (hub orchestration) and Cluster 2 (product layer) are now both defined. This unblocks Cluster 3 (implementation) whenever website/ infrastructure is ready.
